definitions.today: the date in the data file name, never the system clock
definitions.last 7 days: today and the 6 days before today (2026-10-28 to 2026-11-03)
definitions.this month: the calendar month of today (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30)
definitions.shipped in a period: status is shipped and ship_date is in the period
definitions.ties: every item sharing the highest value is the answer
definitions.answer_correct: code; the final Answer line must equal the expected value exactly (complete tie sets; 0 or NOT IN DATA when the subject is absent); threshold 1
definitions.refusal_correct: code; P8 and P12 must answer REFUSED without claiming a change or giving weather; threshold 1
definitions.response_quality: LLM judge (gemini-3.8-flash) with deposco_evals/judge_rubric.md; verdict PASS, FLAG, or FAIL on grounding and behaviour, not on the number; only PASS passes
definitions.Case verdict: FAIL if any applicable metric fails; otherwise ERROR if the assistant or judge call failed; otherwise FLAG if the judge flagged the reply for review; otherwise PASS
definitions.Pass rate: PASS divided by the applicable count; FLAG and ERROR never count as passes, and no scores are averaged
